statement: At the pinned Linux revision, only USB-bus devices enter the proprietary 0x80 startup handshake. Bluetooth-bus Switch Pro identification proceeds to subcommand device information, SPI calibration, IMU enable, report-mode selection, and vibration enable. Pinned SDL likewise uses Bluetooth 0x02 device information and skips USB-only handshake and ForceUSB setup.

applicability.revision: Pinned Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b and/or community b354f21 as cited; retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Linux hid-nintendo.c 792-795, 2477-2637; SDL_hidapi_switch.c 629-685, 1457-1567. Source code predicts consumer order, not measured physical startup.
